pr.body: Text fields with a manually set content type were serialized as file parts carrying filename="". Keep them as text parts carrying only their content type across hoppscotch-common, the kernel relay adapter, the desktop Rust relay and the CLI, while preserving real file names and content types. Closes # ### What's changed ### Notes to reviewers --- ## Summary by cubic Fixes multipart serialization so text fields with a manually set content type are no longer sent as file parts carrying `filename=""`. They now stay text parts carrying only their content type, across `hoppscotch-common`, the kernel relay adapter, the desktop Rust relay, and the CLI. Real filenames and content types are preserved for file fields. Written for commit 455b33578c0b8c56f37f60502724b0812854016e. Summary will update on new commits.
pr.title: fix(common): do not add filename to text fields in multipart requests
